scenes.caveat: Training residual is not independent test accuracy. z=f(x,y) does not reliably represent vertical walls; rejected observations remain visible. No FSGP-paper accuracy claim.

max_abs_error.definition: max_j(abs(f_i(x_j,y_j)-z_j)) over the same 30 training neighbors; vertical error in meters
max_abs_error.unsolved: NaN in binary, empty fields in CSV; never zero-filled
max_abs_error.caveat: Training residual, not independent accuracy or adjacent-model disagreement. Rejected solved fits retain errors.

status_patches.geometry: All valid independent polynomial patches; same support clipping and 5x5 display grid, no 3000-function sampling cap
status_patches.assembly_definition: A function is assembled iff its seed appears in at least one final retained triangle; some of its other candidate triangles can still be rejected
status_patches.missing: Invalid/unsolved functions have no fabricated surface; status-colored center markers represent them
